posts.title: Project: Prusa Core 1 Init
posts.description: This weekend I received the kit for the Prusa Core 1 in the mail. I decided to get a Prusa Core 1 to replace my Sovol SV06, mainly because after about a month of fiddling with it, I couldn't get my SV06 to work anymore.
